question.text: If <math><mi>A</mi></math> and <math><mi>B</mi></math> are two events such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mi>A</mi></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>7</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo></math> <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>∩</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>28</mn></mfrac></math> and the conditional probability <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mfrac><mi>A</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msup><mi>A</mi><mi>c</mi></msup><mo>∪</mo><msup><mi>B</mi><mi>c</mi></msup></mrow></mfenced></mfrac></mfenced></math> (where <math><msup><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow></msup></math> denotes the compliment of the event <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math>) is equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>λ</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>26</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>λ</mi></mrow></mfrac></math> is equal to
